_categories: Map any label -> where quark-auto-save saves inside your Quark account (quark_root) and where to download locally (library). Add as many as you like.
_default_category: Category autodl/subs use when --category is not passed.
_movie_library: Optional. When set, autodl also detects theatrical-movie folders (剧场版) in a share and downloads the main file + a Chinese sub into <movie_library>/<Title (year)>/. Empty = skip movies.
_catalog_file: Optional. An anime-taste style catalog JSON ([{name, link, tmdb_id?}, ...]) used by autodl/subs to resolve a share link to a show name and TMDB id. Empty = fall back to the share's own title + TMDB search.
_archive_passwords_file: Where autodl stashes unpack-password candidates parsed from a share (decoy folder names / password txt) so sync can try them with 7z. Relative paths resolve next to config.json.
_owner: Optional 'user:group' to chown downloaded files (needs root). Empty = leave as-is.
_download: Quark throttles single connections hard (~100 KB/s for free accounts). aria2c with N connections bypasses it (≈67 MB/s in testing). Install aria2c; falls back to curl if missing.

tmdb._doc: Provide api_key OR bearer_token, OR point env_file at a file containing TMDB_API_KEY=... / TMDB_BEARER_TOKEN=...

rename._doc: Bundled standalone TMDB renamer -> 'Title - SxxExx - Episode Name.ext'. Set enabled=false to keep raw SxxExx names.

_notify: List of notification sinks. Each new-episode batch sends {msg}. Remove all for no notifications.

notify._doc: Runs a local command; {msg} is replaced by the message text. Example: your own push script.
POST to a URL. json_field set -> sends JSON {<field>: msg}; omit json_field -> sends raw text body.
